open.notFound: The file was not found. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.
open.unsupported: This file type is not supported.
open.failed: The file could not be opened. It may be damaged or contain unsupported content.
open.accessDenied: You do not have permission to read this file.
open.locked: The file is locked by another program. Close the other program and try again.
open.irm: This file is protected with Information Rights Management (IRM) and cannot be opened.
open.encryptedPpt: Password-protected PowerPoint 97-2003 presentations cannot be opened. Save the presentation without a password or as PPTX in PowerPoint and try again.

create.failed: The new document could not be created.
create.pdfUnsupported: A blank PDF cannot be created. Open a PDF file or export a document as PDF.

save.failed: The file could not be saved. Your original file was not changed.
save.accessDenied: You do not have permission to save here, or the file is read-only. Try saving to another location. Your original file was not changed.
save.locked: The file is in use by another program. Close the other program and try again. Your original file was not changed.
save.diskFull: There is not enough free disk space. Free up space and try again. Your original file was not changed.
save.pathTooLong: The file path is too long. Choose a shorter name or folder.
save.folderMissing: The target folder was not found.
save.verifyFailed: The saved file failed verification, so your original file was not overwritten. Try saving in another format or location.
save.engineFailed: The document engine could not write the file. Your original file was not changed.
save.formatNotWritable: This format cannot be saved. Choose another format.
save.wrongKind: This document cannot be saved as the selected file type.
save.usePdfExport: Use "Export as PDF" to create a PDF.
save.targetOpen: This file is open in another Simpaper tab. Close that tab first or choose a different name.
save.notFound: The document is no longer open.
save.notReady: The document is not ready yet. Try again in a few seconds.

export.failed: The PDF could not be exported.
export.notSupported: This document cannot be exported as PDF.

engine.unavailable: The document engine was not found or could not start. Documents, spreadsheets and presentations cannot be opened; PDF files can still be used.
engine.restored: The document was restored from the latest automatic recovery copy. Check the changes you made after that copy.
engine.restoredFromSaved: The document was reopened from its last saved state; unsaved changes could not be recovered.
engine.restarted: The document engine was restarted and the document was reopened.
engine.restartLimit: The document engine closed repeatedly with this document, so automatic restarts were stopped. You can restart the engine manually, or close the document and restore it from the recovery list.
engine.restoreUnavailable: The document engine closed and there is no recovery copy of this document. Close the document.
engine.restoreFailed: The document could not be reopened after the document engine closed.
engine.timeout: The document engine did not respond in time.
engine.busy: The document engine is busy. If a dialog is open, close it and try again.
engine.notResponding: The document engine is not responding. A long operation may be running; please wait. If it does not recover, restart the document engine, or close the document and restore it from the recovery list.
engine.responding: The document engine is responding again.
engine.restartNotNeeded: The document engine is running; it does not need to be restarted.

command.unavailable: This command is not available in Simpaper.
command.macrosDisabled: For your security, Simpaper never runs macros.
command.remoteUnsupported: Remote files are not supported. Save the file to your computer and open it.

recovery.available: Documents from a session that closed unexpectedly can be recovered.
recovery.notFound: The recovery copy was not found.
recovery.restoreFailed: The recovery copy could not be opened.

settings.invalid: The setting value is not valid.

pdf.unavailable: The PDF service is not available.

notice.macrosDisabled: This document contains macros. Macros are not run; they are kept if you save in a macro-enabled format.
notice.readOnly: The file is read-only. Use "Save As" to save your changes.
